subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Baseline and Benchmarking
description: A quick win: understand Baseline and Benchmarking.

hook.text: The API now takes 800 milliseconds. Is that good or bad? Without a baseline, nobody can tell.

buildup.text: A baseline is a reference measurement taken under controlled conditions for future comparison.

discovery.text: Benchmarking compares current performance against that baseline to detect regressions or gains.

twist.text: Baselines must be refreshed. A two-year-old baseline doesn't account for data growth or new features.

climax.text: Weekly benchmark runs catch a 15% regression from a new feature before it reaches production.

punchline.text: Without a baseline, you're just guessing whether things got worse.

quiz.question: What is a performance baseline?
options: A reference measurement for future comparison
